risks.risk: Gear system may not shift correctly (seller says 'gear' but photo doesn’t show drivetrain condition or gear indexing).
risks.proof: Video clip of riding and shifting through all gears (front and rear) while pedaling, plus close-up of the gear cluster/derailleur.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a bicycle with unverified/possibly non-working gears (worst case: treat as not shifting well).

risks.risk: Brakes may be weak or not responsive (seller mentions 'break' but no brake close-up or test).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of brake pads and calipers/rims + short clip braking from slow speed and stopping safely.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes not guaranteed (worst case: assume needs service).

risks.risk: Wheel alignment, tire condition, and bearing noise not visible (one photo angle only).
risks.proof: Spin each wheel in a video and show tire tread + check for wobble; listen for bearing grinding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tires/bearings may need attention (worst case: assume service required).

risks.risk: Exact type/size (kids vs adult) and whether it’s a single-speed or multi-gear affects value.
risks.proof: Photo of the full bike straight-on showing drivetrain and any gear shifters; measure frame size or show size marking.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for an unconfirmed small/entry bicycle.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the gear shifters, rear derailleur, and rear cassette/gear cluster.
Video: ride and shift through all gears smoothly (front and rear if present).
Close-up photos of brakes (front and rear) and a short braking test clip.
Video: spin both wheels to check wobble and bearing noise; show tire tread condition.
